content.text:
The BOM input now parses correctly: `{"abc":5,"cba":["Xyz","Zyx"]}`.

**Cause:** the parser skips a leading BOM (`\uFEFF`) by advancing `state.position`. It left `state.lineStart` at 0. The first line's indentation, computed as `position - lineStart`, came out as 1 instead of 0. That made `abc` look indented one column, so `cba:` on the next line no longer lined up with it and the parser raised "end of the stream or a document separator is expected".

**Fix:** in `src/parser/parser.ts`, after skipping the BOM, I also set `state.lineStart = state.position`.

I rebuilt `dist/` and checked the reporter's input with the BOM prepended. The `node --test "test/core/**/*.test.mjs"` run printed no pass/fail summary lines, so I can't confirm the existing tests pass. I did not add a regression test.
